title: Charge a capped late fee on overdue invoices

comments.author: reviewer1
comments.body: Please rename `amt` to `amount_cents` so the unit is explicit at the call site.

comments.author: agent
comments.body: Done — the parameter is `amount_cents` throughout. Separately, while I was in the file I noticed `fee` carries no unit suffix either. Happy to rename it to `fee_cents` if you want the whole module consistent; leaving it as it is otherwise, since it is outside what you asked for.
